## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] The working tree was reviewed.
- [ ] `git diff --check` passes.
- [ ] Data provenance is documented where relevant.
- [ ] No restricted or identifiable raw data are included.
- [ ] Software versions are recorded where relevant.
- [ ] Figures/tables support the quantitative claims being made.
- [ ] Known limitations are documented.
- [ ] README/CITATION metadata remain consistent.

## Notes

Add anything reviewers need to reproduce or interpret the change.
